observations: Blanket push/tuck/push gives Buddy an immediate independent practical want; Neet wants rank. Heather participates physically rather than only commenting. The captain-to-sweater replacement earns Promotion filled after the image, preserving the reveal.

All distinctive original travel incidents remain in order: suitcase socks, conveyor, moving cart, detector, cockpit/fortress, takeoff fear, big-car reassurance, attendant pretzels, packed Buddy treat, cow on descent. Generic future-adventure preview was already absent in prior edition; no new incident loss.

Buddy acts despite his own engine anxiety, reassures Neet, shares the successful lying-down solution, then relaxes. His dry voice and Neet self-protective Better grip preserve affection rather than humiliation.

Airport cart hostility returns as snack-cart enthusiasm with a concrete reason. Opened packet controls the self-appointed captain; picture shows the reversal after it occurs rather than announcing it early.

Three images contribute distinct stages: competing packing priorities, vulnerable reassurance, recovered attention redirected to snacks. Two cabin views intentionally echo surroundings but alter pose, gaze, human participation and narrative function.

Ending retains cow curiosity and blanket comfort, then pays captain authority with You are flying it and Neet serious window inspection. No final illustration interrupts or spoils that small last joke.
Historical Heather-only household and inherited breed wording remain; no new Sagar insertion, anatomy authority or owner canon asserted.
